title: Liveness and readiness for an ad event ingester
name: Ingest service health checks

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this service reports its health to the orchestrator? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The geoip cache is unreachable but ClickHouse and Kafka are fine. What does /healthz/ready return?
Ten readiness probes arrive at the same moment with an empty cache. How many times is each dependency pinged?
choices: Once, because later probes await the same in-flight promise
Zero, because the cache is used
Once per probe that arrives after the timeout

questions.prompt: ClickHouse's ping hangs indefinitely. What does a readiness probe observe?
choices: The probe hangs until the orchestrator's own timeout
A fail result for clickhouse after checkTimeoutMs, with the ping's signal aborted, and a 503
The process is restarted by the liveness probe
A pass result because the ping never rejected
